prompt_preview:
You are a consultant at Tessera Advisory (a fictional firm) writing a proposal deck for Falaj Health Partners on "Patient Experience and Clinical Operations Transformation".
Write the text for EXACTLY 16 slides, following each brief closely.
Rules:
- Confident consulting language in your OWN words.

slides.title: Patient Experience and Clinical Operations Transformation: proposal to Falaj Health Partners
bullets: Submitted by Tessera Advisory
October 2026
slides.notes: Opening slide for the proposal submission.

slides.title: About Tessera Advisory
bullets: We are a boutique firm specializing in healthcare operational excellence.
Our team holds ISO 27001 certification for information security.
Protecting data entrusted to us is a core value of our firm.
slides.notes: Highlighting our firm's commitment to internal data security.

slides.title: Our understanding
bullets: Falaj Health Partners faces increasing expectations from a growing patient base.
Facility density currently challenges standard care delivery throughput.
Workforce shortages are impacting operational consistency and staff wellbeing.
slides.notes: Summary of the current challenges identified at Falaj.

slides.title: Our approach
bullets: Listen: We engage stakeholders to capture the current operational reality.
Measure: We quantify performance gaps using robust evidence.
Design: We architect solutions tailored to specific clinical needs.
Mobilise: We support the transition to new operational models.

slides.title: Phase 1: Listen
bullets: Examine end-to-end care pathways across the entire network of sixteen hospitals and clinics.
Conduct sixty-plus sessions to capture feedback from patients, nurses, and physicians.

slides.title: Phase 2: Measure
bullets: Quantify appointment delays for all outpatient services.
Evaluate queue lengths using two years of historical records.
Identify bottlenecks influencing patient flow in non-acute areas.
slides.notes: Focusing on data-driven analysis of outpatient throughput.

slides.title: Phase 3: Design the digital experience
bullets: Propose a seamless online booking system for patient appointments.
Develop a mobile application to improve patient access and engagement.
slides.notes: Outlining digital tools to enhance patient experience.

slides.title: Phase 3: Design the workforce model
bullets: Construct a dynamic rostering engine for clinical staff.
Align doctor and nurse shifts with anticipated patient volumes.
Ensure staffing levels effectively match predicted demand patterns.
slides.notes: Describing the logic behind our workforce planning tools.

slides.title: Programme leadership
bullets: Establish an executive steering board to provide strategic oversight.
Convene monthly meetings to review performance indicators.
Utilize a balanced scorecard to track progress against objectives.
slides.notes: Describing the management structure for the engagement.

slides.title: Building capability
bullets: Launch a dedicated training academy.
Focus on skill development for nursing staff at the four hospitals.
Enhance clinical competencies to support operational improvements.

slides.title: What you will receive
bullets: Current-state baseline report on patient experience and operations.
Prioritized, sequenced plan of initiatives for implementation.
Operational cockpit transferred to your in-house technology team.
slides.notes: Summary of tangible outputs from the engagement.

slides.title: Workplan
bullets: The total engagement duration is 20 weeks.
Mid-programme readout of results scheduled for week 10.
Status note provided to the executive sponsor every Thursday.

slides.title: Your team
bullets: Sarah Jenkins: Engagement Lead with deep operational expertise.
Dr. Ahmed Al-Farsi: Clinical Advisor, former Chief Medical Officer with 15 years experience.
Marcus Thorne: Digital Experience Lead for app development.
Elena Rossi: Workforce Planning Specialist.
Omar Khalid: Operations Analyst; all team members are fluent in English and Arabic.
slides.notes: Introducing the project team and language capabilities.

slides.title: Commercial proposal
bullets: Fixed fee structure for the entire engagement duration.
Installment payment schedule linked to specific project milestones.
Invoices payable within 30 days of contract.

slides.title: Relevant experience
bullets: References from three healthcare clients available upon request.
Proprietary benchmarking database includes over 200 hospitals worldwide.
slides.notes: Demonstrating our firm's track record and data assets.

slides.title: Why Tessera and next steps
bullets: Unmatched expertise in clinical operations and patient experience.
Data-driven methodology ensuring sustainable operational outcomes.
Tailored approach reflecting the unique needs of Falaj Health Partners.
Please let us know your availability for a follow-up meeting.
slides.notes: Closing arguments and call to action.
